description: The identity of the first-coordinate preordered real plane cannot factor through its ordered quotient as a function back to the plane.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.plane_identity_not_factor :
  ¬∃ g, ∀ (p : Lemmatheca.Entry.OrderedSets.PreorderedPlane), g (toAntisymmetrization (fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2) p) = p
